title: Exhaustively Verified BF16 GPU & ML Math Kernels
tagline: 65,536/65,536 bfloat16 exhaustive pure-data verifier · zero JS execution
question: How few branchless FMA/bit-ALU ops compute exact BF16 GELU, SiLU, exp2, and rsqrt across all 65,536 inputs?
description: Discover ultra-short, branchless float32 FMA/bit-ALU instruction schedules for the four hottest LLM GPU elementwise kernels — BF16 rsqrt (RMSNorm), exp2 (FlashAttention softmax), SiLU (Llama/Qwen FFN), and GELU (GPT/ViT FFN). Every pure-data JSON artifact is exhaustively checked across ALL 65,536 IEEE bfloat16 bit patterns (including subnormals, ±0, ±Inf, and NaN) at ≤ 1 ULP with zero sampling and zero untrusted code execution, and auto-exports ready-to-paste CUDA __device__ code.
verdict: open world record hunt — accepting token donations.

impact.ships_to: FlashAttention, Triton, PyTorch Inductor, vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, llama.cpp
impact.bottleneck: On modern GPUs (H100/B200/MI300), Special Function Units (SFU: exp2, rsqrt, tanh) have 4–8× lower throughput than FMA/ALU pipes, making softmax, RMSNorm, and SwiGLU/GELU activations major fusion stalls inside FlashAttention and LLM decoders.
impact.what_one_step_buys: Each branchless FMA/ALU op shaved off an exhaustively verified ≤1-ULP bf16 kernel directly lowers register pressure and instruction count across trillions of daily inference tokens with a 100% mathematical guarantee of zero NaN/edge-case regressions.

consumers.name: FlashAttention / Triton Softmax
consumers.detail: Online softmax calls exp2 on every attention score tile; fast FMA+bitcast exp2 offloads congested GPU SFU pipes.

consumers.name: vLLM / llama.cpp / PyTorch Inductor
consumers.detail: RMSNorm (rsqrt), SwiGLU (SiLU), and GELU run on every Transformer layer; auto-exported __device__ C/CUDA drops straight into fused kernels.

consumers.name: TPU / Custom NPU & Edge Compilers
consumers.detail: Pure FMA + integer bit-ALU kernels run without hardware transcendental tables on RISC-V RVV, WebGPU, and custom NPUs.

examples.mechanism: Verified pf.mlkernel.v1 JSON compiles 1-to-1 into branchless CUDA `__device__ float pf_bf16_rsqrt(float)` using integer bitcast + FMA Newton refinement.
examples.metric: 65,536/65,536 bf16 inputs verified ≤ 1 ULP (incl. subnormals, +0→+Inf, neg/NaN→NaN) without invoking hardware rsqrt/div.

examples.mechanism: Range reduction + minimax FMA polynomial + IEEE exponent bit-shift exports directly to Triton / CUDA attention inner loops.
examples.metric: Zero SFU contention and zero overflow/underflow NaN traps across the entire 16-bit bfloat16 domain.

examples.mechanism: Eliminates separate `expf`/`erff`/`tanhf` + division calls in fused MLP epilogues; drop-in C/CUDA generated in every verified dossier.
examples.metric: Matches exact float64 SiLU / erf-GELU to ≤ 1 bf16 ULP across all 65,536 bit patterns with zero lookup tables.
